title: Title
titleHtmlHelp: Defines the title of the page in search results or on the page's tab. It should be under 60 characters.
descriptionHtmlHelp: A short and accurate summary of the content of the page used in search results. It should be between 50-160 characters.
robotsHtmlHelp: Search engine indexing setting. To let Google fully index and crawl your page, leave these UNCHECKED. Learn more about these options
robotsNoFollow: Do not crawl links on page (nofollow)
robotsTxtSelectionHelp: This setting will add a robots.txt file to determine if search engines can index this site. Disallowing will block for all pages, if you allow indexing, you can still block specific pages.
robotsTxtAllow: Allow search engines to index this site
robotsTxtDisallow: Disallow search engines from indexing this site
robotsCustomText: Text to be added to the robots.txt file
gtmIdHelp: Container ID provided in Google Tag Manager (e.g., GTM-RPCVDTN).
gaIdHelp: Tracking ID provided by Google Analytics.
googleVerifyIdHelp: Verification ID provided by Google for the HTML meta tag verification option.
canonicalHelp: Is there a main version of this page that search engines should direct to?
canonicalModuleHelp: Is there a main version of this {{ type }} that search engines should direct to?
organizationInfoHelp: Details about your organization for structured data
schemaTypeHelp: Select the type of structured data to generate for this content
siteCanonicalUrlHelp: Base URL (including protocol) used in structured data and canonicals.
productDetailsHelp: Fields to describe this product for structured data.
productNameHelp: Shown in search results; keep it concise.
businessDetailsHelp: Fields to describe this business for LocalBusiness schema.
siteNameHelp: The name of your website for JSON-LD structured data
siteDescriptionHelp: A brief description of your website
includeItemListHelp: When enabled, Collection Pages include an ItemList of visible items in structured data.
twitterHandleHelp: Your Twitter/X username including the @ symbol (e.g., @yourhandle) for social media cards.
defaultOGImageHelp: Fallback image for social media sharing when a page doesn't have a featured image.
skuHelp: Your internal product identifier or stock number.
gtinHelp: Global Trade Item Number - UPC, EAN, ISBN, or other product barcode.
ratingHelp: Average customer rating on a scale of 0-5 stars.
reviewCountHelp: Total number of customer reviews for this product.
faqDetailsHelp: Frequently Asked Questions that can appear as rich snippets in search results.
question: Question
videoDetailsHelp: Structured data for videos helps them appear in video search results.
videoNameHelp: The title of the video as it should appear in search results.
videoDurationHelp: Video duration in ISO 8601 format (e.g., PT1H30M for 1 hour 30 minutes).
videoUrlHelp: Direct URL to the video file or embed URL.
videoEmbedUrlHelp: URL for embedding the video (e.g., YouTube embed URL).
